equity.level_reason: Age only defines the per capita denominator (adults aged ≥18 years); sales data carry no consumer demographics, and no SPD is compared.

level_alternative.reason: The limitations mention missing consumer demographics and untaxed sales on American Indian sovereign lands, which could be read as equity raised only as a limitation.

notes: The design is not named; surveillance/descriptive with trend is inferred from national excise-tax series. The comparison is led by the headline 2000–2015 change, with year-to-year changes across 16 years and several products. Advertising and tax avoidance are offered only as explanations of overall trends.
view_issues: Footnote § defines small cigars as weighing ≥3 pounds per 1,000 and large cigars as >3 pounds, which overlap; the Figure 2 note renders it as '=3'. The Table marks the per capita smokeless change (4.2%) as not significant, and the text gives no p-value for it.
